newsitem.title: FRANCE: SHV, Primagaz in talks about Calor.
newsitem.headline: SHV, Primagaz in talks about Calor.

text.p: French Primagaz said in a statememt on Tuesday that it and Dutch group SHV had started talks about merging Calor Gas into Primagaz.
SHV Energy NV has obtained all shares of Calor Group Plc SHV is also a main shareholder in Primagaz.
The transaction is expected to be completed later in 1997 pending regulatory approval. It concerns Calor's gas activities in Britain, North Ireland and the Irish Republic.
Primagaz said it expected its first half profit to be below that of the year 1996 and hoped that for the full year period its growth plans would boost the result.
Primagaz made a 1996 net profit of 371 million francs, a rise of 11 percent, and the net dividend was increased by 12 percent to 8.50 franc per share.
